content.what_it_is: An extended-format, case-sorted Exuberant Ctags 5.8 cross-reference index for the FUNWAVE-GPU Fortran and Makefile sources. Each tag maps a symbol or numeric label to a source filename, anchored search pattern, tag kind, and where available module/subroutine/program scope (lines 1-1235).
entities: Ctags metadata header defining extended format, sort mode, author, program name, URL, and version (lines 1-6)
Numeric statement labels and A-C symbols, including modules, subroutines, variables, functions, program, and Makefile macros (lines 7-200)
D-I symbols covering derivatives, hydrodynamic fields, I/O, fluxes, GPU interfaces, and initialization (lines 201-400)
I-P symbols covering wave initialization, domain decomposition, meteorology, sediment, outputs, and parameters (lines 401-600)
P-U symbols covering boundary exchange, input readers, sponge, statistics, tracer, tridiagonal solvers, and GPU mask routines (lines 601-800)
U-Z and lowercase A-C symbols covering coupling fields, vessel/wave variables, CUDA kernels, module names, and diagnostics (lines 801-1000)
Lowercase C-U symbols covering GPU upload/download routines, dispersion and tridiagonal kernels, runtime state, sediment variables, and exchange helpers (lines 1001-1200)
Final lowercase U-Z symbols covering mask kernels, upload routines, friction variables, timing, breaking, and wave-speed routines (lines 1201-1235)

verbatim_spans.text: !_TAG_FILE_FORMAT	2	/extended format; --format=1 will not append ;" to lines/
zero	mod_param.F	/^       REAL(SP), PARAMETER:: zero /;"	v	module:PARAM

unresolved: This derived index contains no generation timestamp or source hashes, so the artifact alone cannot establish whether its tags are synchronized with the referenced source files (lines 1-6).

Several symbols have multiple entries because of repeated declarations, scopes, or source patterns; the index does not disambiguate which occurrence a consumer should prefer, for example DX, Ibeg, U1p, U4xL, and myvar (lines 216-218, 424-427, 775-776, 781-782, 1082-1086).

Some stored search patterns are visibly truncated or preserve likely source misspellings, including N entries cut after INT, l cut after INTEGER :: nreq,le, and n_suth/Contant_Wind_Field_Setup; whether these are intentional source names or defects is unresolved in the index (lines 526-527, 1076, 1087-1089, 190).
